The '''''Seeker Cub''''' was a customized [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighter]] that belonged to the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Starter]]. During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Starter often flew missions for the [[Black Curs]].
